nota: Los textos de los anuncios del Agora en esta lengua. Salieron de `anuncios.json` el 2026-09-23: con nueve lenguas dentro le quedaban 344 B del tope de 16 KB y el siguiente anuncio ya no cabia. `anuncios.json` se queda con los HECHOS (id, tipo, autor, fecha, enlace, estado); esto trae lo que se lee, por id. Mismo corte que el taller, los paneles y el Agora.

feedback.cuerpo: What broke, what you did not understand, what you expected to find and was not there. One concrete sentence beats any praise.
feedback.publico: Public: sign a thread below. It is signed with your key, on your device.
feedback.privado: Private: open an issue on the public repository. It is the only channel that actually arrives today.
feedback.pero: NO_DATA — the Agora answers now, but it does not accept writing yet: POST /api/v1/threads returns 405, and the server says so in its own words: «writing closed: the Agora does not moderate yet» (measured 2026-09-08). It is signed and stays on your device until it opens.

entrenar.cuerpo: Bring your own set of examples and a LoRA adapter comes out, trained on the rack. No GPU needed: it runs on plain CPU and it is measured.
entrenar.publico: Measured 2026-08-29: rank 16, alpha 32, 2 epochs, 93 training and 16 validation examples. 553 s one line, 445 s the other. Under ten minutes, not overnight.
entrenar.privado: The set of examples is yours and stays yours. What gets shared, if you want to, is the adapter that comes out.
